integrity: The proof explicitly constructs formulas for every singleton world and proves sharpness by atom counts. Finite diagnostics corroborate but do not certify the all-n theorem. Originality is assessed against identified published literature with residual priority risk.
scientific_limitations: The full unrestricted Kripke complex algebra is studied, not the principal-downset parameter valuations of the motivating forcing semantics.
No claim concerns infinite atom sets, arbitrary induced subframes, or optimal modal depth or formula length.
No independent scientific audit has been performed; older specialized literature could contain an equivalent representation.
title: A one-variable generator for every finite Boolean compatibility frame
